rita_docs: FYI PR #4302 (link fix + migration examples) has Netlify preview but the links in the sidebar break when previewing a specific path (e.g., opening /sdk/rust/ shows the sidebar entries pointing to /sdk/rust instead of /sdk/rust/). Netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-4302--redwood-docs.netlify.app :confused:

ci-bot: Build succeeded but linkcheck reported 2 broken links in generated site: /sdk/rust -> 301 to /sdk/rust/ and sidebar hrefs missing trailing slash.

mike_platform: this is usually the mkdocs-material plugin behavior. Did you set `use_directory_urls: true` in mkdocs.yml?

rita_docs: yes `use_directory_urls: true`. The templates generate sidebar hrefs using `{{ page.url | replace('index.html','') }}` and some pages end up without trailing slash. I tried forcing `{{ page.url }}{% if not page.url.endswith('/') %}/{% endif %}` but Jinja filter isn't available on some builds.

mike_platform: workaround: add a small JS snippet to normalize sidebar links on load: `document.querySelectorAll('.md-sidebar a').forEach(a=>{ if (!a.pathname.endsWith('/')) a.pathname += '/'; })` — add it to base template in an inline script. Not ideal but quick.

rita_docs: pushed inline script and retriggered Netlify.

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded: https://deploy-preview-4302--redwood-docs.netlify.app :white_check_mark:

rita_docs: thanks. can someone review the migration example on the SDK page? @mike_platform can you eyeball the quick JS fix is okay for previews? Not ideal for prod but acceptable for now.

mike_platform: fine for preview. We should open a follow-up issue to patch the mkdocs plugin or adjust templates properly. Approved from infra side.

ci-bot: Reminder: when merging, add `#skip-preview` to the merge commit message only if you want to skip the preview deploy (not recommended).

rita_docs: good call. aiming to merge tonight at 23:45 UTC slot.

mike_platform: sounds good. Give a heads-up here before you push the merge so SRE can watch the staging deploy.
